tasks.intent: Retrieve the invoice record using its unique identifier to access billing data including quantity, price, and purchase order reference.
Search for the purchase order corresponding to the invoice's PO number to establish contractual baselines for quantity and pricing.
Retrieve the goods receipt record to verify the physically delivered quantities confirmed against this purchase order.
Fetch the configured tolerance limits for price variance percentage and absolute monetary differences from the processing rules sheet.
Check whether a matching Purchase Order can be found

rules.name: Purchase Order Existence Check
rules.statement: A valid purchase order corresponding to the invoice PO number must exist in the system before any financial review can proceed.
rules.trueMeans: A valid purchase order exists for this invoice, allowing financial verification to proceed.

rules.name: Quantity Matching Requirement
rules.statement: The invoiced quantity must not exceed the quantity recorded as physically received in the goods receipt.
rules.trueMeans: The billed quantity does not exceed the physically received quantity.

rules.name: Percentage Price Variance Limit
rules.statement: The invoice unit price may deviate from the purchase order unit price only up to a specified maximum percentage threshold.
rules.trueMeans: The price deviation stays within the acceptable percentage threshold.

rules.name: Absolute Difference Cap
rules.statement: The total monetary overcharge derived from the price difference multiplied by quantity must not exceed a fixed maximum amount.
rules.trueMeans: The total monetary overcharge remains below the configured cap.

decisions.intent: Route to MANUAL_REVIEW when the Purchase Order Existence Check check fails
Route to WAREHOUSE_REVIEW when the Quantity Matching Requirement check fails
Route to PROCUREMENT_REVIEW when the Percentage Price Variance Limit check fails
Route to PROCUREMENT_REVIEW when the Absolute Difference Cap check fails
[ASSUMED, not in original IR] If none of the four checks above triggered a review, release the invoice.

openQuestions: Does under-delivery (invoice qty < received qty) trigger any review or auto-release?

Are there other tolerance rules or exceptions not captured in the demonstrated scenarios?
How are partial deliveries handled if multiple goods receipts exist for one PO?
